description.zh: 资源ID列表，n 的取值范围为 [1, 50]
description.en: A list of resource IDs. The value of n can be from 1 to 50.

description.zh:
标签列表。
当key和value与已存标签不同时，会新建标签。
> 可通过ListResourceTags接口获取到实例标签列表。
description.en:
The list of tags. If the key and value of a tag are different from existing tags, a new tag is created.

> Use the ListResourceTags operation to get the list of tags for an instance.

description.zh: 标签键，n 的取值范围为 [1, 20]。
description.en: The tag key. The value of n can be from 1 to 20.

description.zh: 标签值，n 的取值范围为 [1, 20]。
description.en: The value of the tag. The value can contain 1 to 20 characters.
